title: The Poisoning Course Timeline
description:
📄 Forensic Report #104:
8:00 PM - Soup served
8:30 PM - Fish served
9:00 PM - Roast served
9:30 PM - Victim collapsed
Medical fact: The poison used takes exactly 60 minutes to cause collapse.
question: Which course was poisoned?
solution: Victim collapsed at 9:30 PM. 60 minutes prior is 8:30 PM, when the Fish course was served.
